claim: 原始队列中斑块MNP检测与后续复合心血管事件相关
estimand: asymptomatic high-grade carotid endarterectomy patients; composite nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, all-cause death
ceiling: association only; not causal or general-population risk

claim: 该关联证明日常MNP暴露导致MI、卒中或死亡
estimand: general-population causal effect of external MNP exposure
evidence: S1 explicitly states no causality; selective surgical population, residual confounding and no exposure-source data

claim: S1的PE/PVC暴露分类已被污染和基质干扰充分排除
estimand: validity of polymer classification in plaque biological matrix
evidence: S1 says contamination cannot be firmly ruled out; S2 operating-room/blank challenge; S4 finds persistent PE/PVC interference in blood; S3 acknowledges lipid interference

claim: 独立人体研究复制了斑块/病变组织中较高MNP信号
estimand: presence or concentration difference in human vascular tissue, not clinical events
evidence: S3 femoral plaque 3234±3629 vs age-matched carotid control 40.68±23.23 μg/g; S6 paired plaque 432.9 vs blood 75.2 μg/g; S7 abstract plaque arteries higher than aorta
ceiling: replicates tissue enrichment, not S1 event HR

claim: 体外/动物机制已把人类观察性关联升级为临床因果
estimand: translation from experimental mechanism to human clinical events
evidence: S5 maps 33 in-vitro studies and human tissue studies but notes heterogeneity and insufficient quantitative synthesis; no intervention or quasi-experiment

claim: Py-GC/MS在生物样本中的PE/PVC质量浓度可直接跨研究比较
evidence: S4 realistic detection limits, recoveries, lipid interference and false-positive patterns; S3 similar PE/PVC limitation; S5 method heterogeneity
ceiling: method-specific values only until harmonized validation

claim: 目前存在独立人体研究复制了MNP检测与临床事件的同一因果关系
estimand: independent replication of exposure classification plus prospective clinical outcome
evidence: S3 and S6 are tissue/distribution studies without S1-style prospective events; S5 reports no reliable quantitative synthesis
